authority: Vocabulary owns spelling, token positions, senses, story steps, prompt text and curricular requirements. Art owns reusable representations and playback layout only.

identity_contract.runtime_instance_id: invocation_id + definition_instance_id; preserve invocation_id on resume

prompt_render_contract.H0: hide story, image chain and answer hints until help is opened; actively opening them changes the observed assistance evidence
prompt_render_contract.H3: missing letter and miniature stay hidden until reveal requested; answer_chain_for_evaluator_only is never UI text
prompt_render_contract.all_levels: log actual shown hints/replays, not just selected level; H0 alone cannot prove independence
prompt_render_contract.audio_missing: show pending/unavailable and permit visual assisted story; never synthesize listening evidence

storage_contract.root_location: Display/content index copied from authored story; not a verified physical node

clock_contract.world_clock: paused during dialogue/memory/teaching, pause menus and application background
clock_contract.performance_clock: necessary story actions and semantic weather may run during dialogue/memory; pause menu/background freeze it
clock_contract.semantic_weather: local reviewed stage preset or static context panel, never wait for random global weather
clock_contract.user_preferences: fixed daylight/clear weather and reduced motion retained; use readable local explanation/static keyframes when needed
clock_contract.learning_time: real evidence timestamps unchanged; no offline catch-up

exact text remains readable in reduced motion
